thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning to push release/2026-q1 into staging today at 15:30 PT. This is the rollout that includes the batching optimizer and a small KV-cache tweak. Please ack if you're the owner for smoke/rollback.

sam: I'm the DB owner for the related migration. timeline ok for me but will be watching the migration window (15:30–15:40). @maria are we doing a migration toggle or full migrate?

maria: full migrate behind a feature flag. We keep the toggle in case we need immediate rollback. Migration is fast (~30s) but we still want a quick data-check after.

alex: i'll be on-call during the window. I'll run smoke steps and watch latency dashboards. Add me to the incident bridge if anything odd. :bell:

jin: putting the rollback runbook here for quick reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-2026-q1 — TL;DR rollback criteria: 1) error rate > 2% sustained for >5m OR 2) p95 latency regression >150ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive samples OR 3) data integrity check fails. Rollback steps: 
```
- flip feature flag to old path
- roll service to previous tagged image redwood/service@v1.28.3
- run post-rollback smoke (sanity + DB-check)
- notify customers and update incident ticket
```

sam: DB-check steps? can we automate the data-check script?

jin: yes — script lives at infra/scripts/migration_verify.sh, will kick it off as part of smoke. It returns nonzero on mismatch and posts to #incidents.

qa-lead: QA will run the acceptance flow once staging passes smoke. ETA for QA sign-off is +20m after deploy. If any failing flows, we want immediate stop and rollback.

maria: owners: 
- deploy owner: maria
- DB owner: sam
- oncall: alex (ops-oncall watches infra)
- QA lead: qa-lead
Please confirm.

ops-oncall: confirmed — I'll monitor infra metrics and scale signals. If we hit autoscaler errors or node OOMs, call the rollback.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled by @maria at 2365432200 (ETA start 15:30 PT). Canary set to 5% for 10 minutes, then ramp. Auto-fallback enabled to previous image on healthcheck fail.

sam: acked. I'll be ready to run DB rollback steps if something goes sideways.

alex: ack. I'll run the smoke checklist: 
- basic end-to-end request (happy path)
- latency microbench for p50/p95
- error-rate panel check
- KV cache hit-rate check

maria: final go/no-go criteria: all owners ack + canary healthy at 5m. If any owner says stop, we stop. Who's saying go? :eyes: 

qa-lead: go if smoke passes.

sam: go from DB side.

alex: go from oncall.

maria: launching at 2365432200. I'll post final status in this thread. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
